correctness|src/ui/TextRecipeSettings.ts.title: Keep removed optional positions editable after count reduction
correctness|src/ui/TextRecipeSettings.ts.why_it_matters: Configure a four-segment split selecting segment 1, mark segment 4 optional, then change the expected count to 3. The change retains optionalEmpty:[3], but the optional-position checkboxes now render only positions 1–3. validateWorkflowConfiguration rejects the hidden position as split-index, so a source containing three valid segments cannot preview, download or save even though every visible setting is valid. The user must discover that temporarily restoring count 4 exposes the stale checkbox. This affects ordinary editing of an existing split rule.

correctness|src/ui/TextRecipeSettings.ts.suggested_fix: When a valid expected count is reduced, explicitly remove optionalEmpty entries outside the new count and inform the user that removed positions were cleared; alternatively retain visible removable controls for stale optional positions until corrected. Add a browser regression for mark segment 4 optional → reduce count to 3 → valid three-part source → preview/save/download succeed after correction, without requiring a temporary count increase.

adversarial|src/ui/TextRecipeSettings.ts.title: Reducing segment count hides an option that blocks export
adversarial|src/ui/TextRecipeSettings.ts.why_it_matters: After marking segment 4 optional, changing the expected count to 3 leaves an invisible optional position in the recipe. Even when all three visible segments and the selected position are valid, validation blocks preview, downloads and saving; the user must discover that increasing the count again reveals the checkbox that needs clearing. Updating dependent positions when the count changes avoids trapping an otherwise valid configuration behind an invisible setting.
adversarial|src/ui/TextRecipeSettings.ts.suggested_fix: For an accepted valid segment count, filter optionalEmpty to positions below that count and clamp the selected index into range in the same change callback. Preserve temporary invalid numeric input as draft state if needed. Add a browser regression that checks segment 4 as optional, reduces count to 3 and successfully previews/saves a three-segment source without re-expanding the count.
